subject: Mythology
title: The World Reborn After Ragnarök
description: One-minute skill: The World Reborn After Ragnarök.

hook.text: Ragnarök was not the absolute end. After the fires cooled, a new green world rose from the ocean.

buildup.text: Two humans survived by hiding inside Yggdrasil's trunk, protected by the world tree through the apocalypse.

discovery.text: Baldur returned from the dead. A new sun replaced the one the wolves had swallowed. Life began again.

twist.text: The cycle of creation and destruction was not a tragedy. The Norse saw it as nature's inevitable rhythm.

climax.text: Unlike most apocalypse myths, the Norse ending carried hope: destruction was followed by rebirth and renewal.

punchline.text: The world ended so it could begin again, better than before.

quiz.question: How did humans survive Ragnarök in Norse mythology?
options: Odin teleported them to a safe realm
They hid inside the trunk of Yggdrasil
The Valkyries carried them above the destruction
